entries.035af94bb992269b: This business makes and sells magnetic heads and suspensions for hard disk drives (HDDs), as well as magnets. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥262,903 million, accounting for 10.5% of the total. Segment profit for the same year was ¥26,951 million. The company explains that sales volume for HDD magnetic heads for data center nearline HDDs increased by about 14%, and for HDD suspensions by about 35%, resulting in a substantial increase in revenue and profit. The main companies include the company itself, SAE Magnetics (H.K.) Ltd., Magnecomp Precision Technology Public Co., Ltd., Headway Technologies, Inc., TDK Philippines Corporation, and Acrathon Precision Technologies (HK) Ltd., and including the company, 16 companies belong to it.
entries.069e3d9616edbd28: It develops and manufactures electronic components and secondary batteries and sells them to companies that make equipment, generating net sales from those sales. Its reportable [[term:segment|segments]] are four: Passive Components, Sensor Applications, Magnetic Applications and Energy Applications; businesses not included in these are classed as 'Other.' Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,370,304 million for Energy Applications, ¥593,201 million for Passive Components, ¥262,903 million for Magnetic Applications, ¥224,623 million for Sensor Applications and ¥53,789 million for Other, totaling ¥2,504,820 million. The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] lists its major customers as 'ICT-related companies with global operations, automobile and automotive parts manufacturers, home appliance and industrial equipment manufacturers, etc.' Components are not delivered to consumers on their own; they are built into these companies' equipment and used there. Overseas net sales were ¥2,321,360 million, and the ratio of overseas net sales to consolidated net sales was 92.7%.

entries.14092f51c8916309: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥272,415 million, up 21.5% from ¥224,192 million in the previous year. The breakdown of segment profit is Energy Applications ¥246,682 million, Passive Components ¥41,831 million, Magnetic Applications ¥26,951 million, Sensor Applications ¥20,748 million, and Other a loss of ¥10,230 million; adjustments for company-wide operating and management costs and other items of ¥53,567 million are then deducted. Profit before tax was ¥276,810 million, and profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥195,663 million. The company explains that currency fluctuations reduced net sales by about ¥2.5 billion overall and reduced operating profit by about ¥10.6 billion.

entries.1500e058d55f518a: It makes energy application products such as small batteries for smartphones, medium-sized batteries for industrial equipment and power supplies; passive components such as capacitors and coils; magnetic heads and suspensions for HDDs (hard disk drives); and sensors that measure temperature, pressure and magnetism. Production results for the fiscal year ended March 2026, calculated at sales prices, were ¥1,425,429 million for Energy Applications, ¥602,903 million for Passive Components, ¥271,774 million for Magnetic Applications, ¥218,653 million for Sensor Applications and ¥60,402 million for Other, totaling ¥2,579,161 million, an increase of 15.0% from the previous year.
entries.1ef3616d4224e82b: This business makes and sells temperature and pressure sensors, magnetic sensors and MEMS sensors. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥224,623 million, accounting for 9.0% of the total. Segment profit for the same year was ¥20,748 million. The company explains that sales of magnetic sensors increased for smartphone and automotive applications, MEMS sensors for microphones increased for the ICT market, and motion sensors increased for industrial equipment. The main companies include the company itself, InvenSense, Inc., and TDK-Micronas GmbH, and including the company, 16 companies belong to it.

entries.265340b4575de8c4: This business manufactures and sells secondary batteries (rechargeable batteries that can be used repeatedly) and power supplies. The main products are small batteries for smartphones, medium-sized batteries for industrial equipment, and power supplies for industrial equipment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,370,304 million, accounting for 54.7% of the total for the 4 reportable segments and other, making it the largest business. Segment profit for the same fiscal year was ¥246,682 million. The company explains that small batteries rose on sales effects of new models, medium-sized batteries increased for the industrial equipment market, and power supplies also rose amid a gradual recovery in demand, resulting in higher revenue and profit. The main companies are the company itself, along with Amperex Technology Limited, Navitasys Technology Limited, Xiamen Ampeak Technology Limited, Navitasys India Private Limited, TDK (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. and others, totaling 33 companies including the company.
entries.278e777d1dcaf8e8: It consists of ceramic capacitors, aluminum electrolytic capacitors and film capacitors. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥257,472 million, the largest of the three passive component businesses. The company explains that sales of ceramic capacitors increased for the automotive and industrial equipment markets, and sales of aluminum electrolytic capacitors and film capacitors increased for the industrial equipment market, including renewable energy and AI server applications.

entries.2f0374ca73c38354: As of March 31, 2026, the group consists of TDK CORPORATION, 152 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] and 6 equity-method associates. The workforce is 106,545 people, broken down by business as follows: Energy Applications 49,507, Passive Components 32,535, Magnetic Applications 10,642, Sensor Applications 6,835, Other 4,252, and company-wide (common) 2,774. Consolidated financial statements are prepared under [[term:ifrs|IFRS]]. Founded in 1935 for the industrialization of magnetic ferrite materials, the annual securities report cites its corporate motto as 'Contributing to culture and industry through creation' and states a policy of deepening its strengths cultivated in areas such as materials, processes and software.
